summary: Frontend-only iteration-3 test of the PC Builder rename + admin manageability, PC Builder content settings, PS5 Controller photo preview and light/dark theme (Playwright, 1920x1080, public preview URL). PASSED: (1) Rename complete - public nav item 'PC Builder' (nav-gaming-pc-konfigurator), /gaming-pc-konfigurator hero H1 'PC Builder', admin sidebar item + tab both 'PC Builder', page title 'PC Builder & Konfiguratoren'. (2) Admin PC Builder category CRUD works end-to-end: create (toast 'Kategorie gespeichert', appears in list), edit name (persists), add option to the new category (visible), delete category (row disappears); seeded categories untouched. (3) Admin Settings 'PC Builder - Inhalte': after adding the missing testids, Titel/Untertitel/Hinweis-Box save (PUT /api/admin/settings 200 + 'Einstellungen gespeichert') and render live on /gaming-pc-konfigurator (H1 = custom title, subtitle, pc-builder-note box). Values reset to empty after the test. (4) PS5 preview now uses REAL controller PHOTOS (, no SVG fallback): dualsense front controller-dualsense-premium.png, back controller-dualsense-back.png, Edge front/back controller-dualsense-edge-official-*.png; front/back switch changes the photo, model switch changes the photo, all 4 assets return 200. builder-save returns a config id (J_NomWpShZg). (5) Theme: toggle switches html.dark, persists via localStorage it_theme after reload; header/footer/admin-login logos all visible in light mode; admin dashboard + sidebar readable in both modes. FAILED / CRITICAL: PS5 variant selection is completely broken - clicking any builder-variant-* never selects anything (summary stays 'Basis: PS5 DualSense', total stays base price, no live recolor/tint). RCA: /api/builder/{model} variants carry NO 'id' field, so in ControllerBuilder.pick() the toggle check `cur?.variant?.id === variant.id` evaluates undefined===undefined => true on the FIRST click and immediately deletes the selection; the same undefined id makes every data-testid literally 'builder-variant-undefined' (52 duplicates -> React duplicate-key warning) and would send variant_id:undefined to /builder/save.

critical.issue: Variant objects have no 'id' (only name/color_hex/price/...). This breaks frontend selection state, testids and the variant_id sent to /api/builder/save. Emit a stable variant id (or index/slug) per variant.

minor.issue: No cascade: options of the deleted category stay in config_options as orphans (verified: 'TEST_QA Option' survived category deletion; I purged it manually). Also returns ok:true for unknown ids instead of 404.
Accepts and stores a configuration with an empty selections object (no validation of required categories) -> returns a config id for an 'empty' controller order.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: selecting a shell/button/stick colour has no effect - no selection highlight state, summary + total never change, controller photo is never tinted (no mix-blend-mode tint layers rendered). Root cause = missing variant.id (see backend issue). Consequence: PS5 builder is unusable and every variant renders data-testid='builder-variant-undefined'.
React console warning 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' (variant buttons keyed by undefined v.id).

integration_issues.issue: builder-save/builder-request return a config id even though nothing can be selected; saved configs contain no selections and only the base price.

issues: Button variant='secondary' ('Kontakt aufnehmen', data-testid final-cta-contact) is invisible: dark text rgb(15,23,42) on the hard-coded dark gradient card bg-gradient-to-br from-[#0f172a]. Same pattern at Leistungen.jsx:82. The secondary/outline variant needs a fixed light foreground when placed on the dark CTA card.

action_items: CRITICAL: add a stable 'id' to each controller variant in the builder API/seed (or key selections by variant name/index in ControllerBuilder.jsx) so PS5 variant selection, live tint, summary/total and variant_id in /builder/save work again.
Fix React duplicate-key warning + 'builder-variant-undefined' testids once variant ids exist.
Light theme: give the secondary/outline Button a light foreground on the dark CTA gradient card (Home.jsx FinalCTA, Leistungen.jsx:82).
Cascade-delete configurator options when a category is deleted (and return 404 for unknown ids).
Validate required categories in POST /api/builder/save (reject empty selections).
Update the seeded FAQ text 'Gaming-PC-Konfigurator' -> 'PC Builder'.
Pre-existing lint error: AdminSettings.jsx:69 unescaped quote in the 'PC Builder' hint text (react/no-unescaped-entities).
critical_code_review_comments: ControllerBuilder.pick() relies on variant.id for both identity and toggle semantics; with an undefined id the equality check makes the first click a de-select. Even after the API adds ids, prefer an explicit toggle on (category_key, variant_key) and guard against undefined identity.

seed_builder.py updates preview_front/preview_back on existing controllers ($set) but variants are only inserted on an empty collection - variant schema changes (like adding ids) need a migration/upsert path.
delete_category has no referential cleanup - config_options keeps documents pointing at a non-existent category_key.

Admin has no theme-toggle; force theme with localStorage.setItem('it_theme','light') + reload. Category delete leaves orphan options in config_options (purge with a regex on name).
rca_of_the_issue: GET /api/builder/{model} returns variants without an 'id' field. In /app/frontend/src/pages/ControllerBuilder.jsx pick() the branch `if (cur?.variant?.id === variant.id) { delete }` compares undefined with undefined, which is true even when nothing is selected, so every click removes the (never created) selection -> no selection state, no price change, no tint layer, no summary entry; the same undefined value produces 52 identical data-testid='builder-variant-undefined' attributes and the React duplicate-key warning. Fix at the source by emitting variant ids from the backend/seed, or key selections by a deterministic variant key in the frontend.
